name: Servicepay Gateway for WooCommerce
author: s1developer

sections.description:
Servicepay Gateway for WooCommerce allows you to accept credit card payments on your store using Servicepay.

External services

This plugin relies on the following third-party services to process payments:

Servicepay API

This plugin connects to the Servicepay payment gateway API to process credit card payments, manage installment payments, and handle payment notifications (webhooks).

  • When data is sent: Every time a customer initiates a payment at checkout, the plugin sends order details (order ID, amount, currency, customer information) to the Servicepay API to create a hosted payment page. The plugin also receives webhook notifications from Servicepay when a payment is completed, refunded, or fails.
  • Production API URL: https://api.servicepay.it
  • Test API URL: https://testapi.servicepay.it
  • Service website: https://servicepay.it
  • Terms of service: https://www.servicepay.it/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/ServicePay_Concessione_Licenza_uso_-da-2025.odt
  • Privacy policy: https://www.privacylab.it/archive.php?id=3413822&idDoc=51&idTarget=505141&output=html

SAIOT API

This plugin connects to the SAIOT API (provided by Soluzione 1 S.r.l.) to send WordPress site information for plugin activation and support purposes.

  • When data is sent: When the store administrator clicks the “Send Contact Request” button in the plugin settings page, the plugin sends site URL, WordPress version, WooCommerce version, and plugin configuration details to the SAIOT API.
  • Production API URL: https://api.saiot.it/saiot-rest/rest/events
  • Test API URL: https://testapi.saiot.it/saiot-rest/rest/events
  • Service website: https://www.soluzione1.it
  • Terms of service: https://www.servicepay.it/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/ServicePay_Concessione_Licenza_uso_-da-2025.odt
  • Privacy policy: https://www.privacylab.it/archive.php?id=3413822&idDoc=51&idTarget=505141&output=html
